Accountabilities:

Design, develop, and maintain a centralized, trusted knowledge infrastructure that makes product documentation, technical resources, business policies, operational procedures, and training materials accessible to AI systems. Implement and manage access controls, data permissions, and security practices to protect sensitive information and ensure compliance with internal IT and security requirements. Hands-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining production-ready AI agents and agentic workflows using large language model platforms and APIs such as Claude, OpenAI, or Gemini. Practical knowledge of agent frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and AI-driven automation architectures. Strong experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), GraphRAG, vector databases, embeddings, prompt engineering, data pipelines, and AI output evaluation. Proficiency in Python or JavaScript and SQL, with a solid understanding of APIs, system integrations, and automation platforms such as Zapier, Workato, or n8n. Experience working with cloud data warehouses and semantic data layers, particularly Snowflake, dbt, or business intelligence platforms such as Omni. Familiarity with knowledge management platforms and enterprise SaaS applications, including Confluence, Notion, Google Workspace, Jira, Salesforce, NetSuite, or Zendesk. Strong information architecture and knowledge organization skills, with exceptional attention to detail and content accuracy. Understanding of data privacy, information security, and access control principles for AI systems, including human-in-the-loop approval processes and audit logging. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Ability to understand business processes, collaborate with subject-matter experts, and translate operational needs into practical technical solutions. Familiarity with lead generation, marketing technology (MarTech), or data products is considered an advantage. Experience developing customer-facing knowledge bases, technical product documentation, or training content is a plus. Willingness to travel approximately 5â10% of the time.
